script: set +e; for getter in /home/azureuser/yoomd-app-token.sh /home/azureuser/yoomd-graph-token.sh; do if [ -x "$getter" ]; then echo "=== using $getter ==="; TOKEN=$($getter 2>/dev/null); R=$(curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" 'https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/identityProtection/riskyUsers?$top=20&$orderby=riskLastUpdatedDateTime%20desc'); echo "$R" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.loads(sys.stdin.read()); v=d.get('value', []); print(f'fetched {len(v)} risky users'); [print(f'- {u.get(\"userDisplayName\")} ({u.get(\"userPrincipalName\")}) | risk={u.get(\"riskLevel\")} | state={u.get(\"riskState\")} | detail={u.get(\"riskDetail\")} | lastUpdated={u.get(\"riskLastUpdatedDateTime\")}') for u in v]" 2>&1; if echo "$R" | grep -q '"value"'; then break; fi; fi; done
